name: Custom Main Levels
description: Add your own levels to the official main levels list (Play button).

show-add-button.name: Show the + button
show-add-button.description: Shows the Add to Main Levels button in the level edit screen. Turn it off for showcases and use the hotkey instead.

button-position.name: Button position
button-position.description: Where the + button appears in the level edit screen.

hide-if-added.name: Hide button when already added
hide-if-added.description: No button if the level is already in the custom list.

add-hotkey.name: Add hotkey
add-hotkey.description: Key that adds the open level (in the level edit screen) to the custom list. Function keys only, so it never clashes with typing.

safe-mode.name: Safe mode
safe-mode.description: Shows the reward message when you complete a custom level, but does NOT change your stats. Recommended: changing stats on an account that uploads scores can get it flagged.
